finding_scope: Unnormalized Boolean Walsh transform of the indicator of all labelled spanning trees of the complete graph, orders n>=3. Full invertibility exactly at odd orders; at even n=2m, the first zero degree is m-1 and first zeros are exactly stars, with exact counts and a first-negative witness at degree m.
integrity: The all-order proof is supplied as elementary matrix-tree/spectral derivation. Integer Prüfer-transform and determinant checks are corroborating finite tests, not formal certification. No external independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify all even-order Fourier zeros or total nullity, nor claim arbitrary host graphs or weighted tree measures. Classical signed matrix-tree and Laplacian bounds are credited. Bounded literature comparison leaves priority risk of unindexed equivalent specialization. Independent mathematical validation was not performed.
title: The sharp Walsh sign boundary for labelled Cayley spanning trees
